name: Web Screenshot
description: Take a picture (PNG) of a public web page as a real browser draws it: a map, a chart, a page layout. The picture is shown to the user and saved in the workspace, so it can go into a PDF with write_pdf. For a map, put the place and the zoom in the page address when the site supports it, and raise 'wait' so the map tiles finish loading.

url.description: Full http(s) address of the page

full_page.description: Capture the whole page height instead of the window (default false)

wait.description: Extra seconds to wait after the page has loaded, 0-20 (default 2; 5-8 for maps)

title.description: Short human title of the picture
